summary: AirSculpt Technologies filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, reporting entry into a new senior secured Financing Agreement among the Company, EBS Intermediate Parent LLC, EBS Enterprises LLC, Blue Torch Finance LLC as agent, and the lenders. The facility comprises a fully funded $39.0 million term loan and an undrawn $5.0 million revolver, maturing November 5, 2031, secured by substantially all assets. Proceeds repaid the existing credit agreement. Pricing is Term SOFR (2.50% floor) plus 6.75%-7.75%, with quarterly amortization beginning December 31, 2026. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation.
